title: Sensitive data sharing without adequate safeguards
description: The wearable device shares GPS traces and device IDs that could be used to track and identify users without proper anonymization or protection.

title: Data interception during transmission
description: Sensor data in transit could be intercepted by third parties, leading to unauthorized access or data tampering.

title: Inadequate data storage security
description: The companion app may store sensitive user data without proper encryption or access controls.

title: Lack of user notification about data sharing
description: Users may not be informed that their sensor data is being shared with the companion app.

title: Unintended data exposure during transmission
description: Data could be exposed to unintended parties during transmission due to lack of encryption or other security measures.

title: User Identity Linked to Health Data
description: User's personal health data (calories, meals, weight) could be used to identify and profile the user, potentially leading to unwanted tracking or discrimination.
assumptions: User voluntarily shares sensitive health information without adequate anonymization

title: Unintended Data Usage
description: User's health data may be used for purposes beyond what the user intended, such as targeted advertising or insurance underwriting.
assumptions: Data is shared without clear consent for all potential uses

title: Data Flow Meta-data Linking
description: Meta-data about the data flow (timing, frequency, content patterns) could be used to link the user to their health activities and profile them.
assumptions: Data transmission patterns are observable and analyzable

title: Unauthorized Data Disclosure
description: Companion app may disclose user's health data to third parties without explicit consent, such as advertisers, insurers, or data brokers.
assumptions: App has access to user data and may share it with external parties

title: Unintended Data Processing
description: App may process user health data for purposes not explicitly agreed to by the user, such as selling data or using it for machine learning training.
assumptions: App has broad data processing capabilities beyond stated purposes

title: Inadequate Data Destruction
description: App may not properly destroy user health data when requested or when the user deletes their account, leading to potential data leakage.
assumptions: App retains data beyond user's control or deletion requests

title: Inappropriate User Identification
description: The companion mobile app may collect and transmit more personal identifying information than necessary for the health logging functionality, potentially including device identifiers, location data, or other metadata that could be used to identify users beyond their health data.
assumptions: Assumes the app collects user data as part of the health logging process

title: Unauthorized Data Sharing
description: The companion mobile app may share health log data with third parties (e.g., advertisers, data brokers, or analytics partners) without explicit user consent or appropriate privacy controls.
assumptions: Assumes the app has mechanisms to share data with external parties

title: Data Interception During Transmission
description: Health log data (calorie intake, weight history, exercise sessions) transmitted from the companion mobile app to the health log store may be intercepted by unauthorized parties during transit, especially if the communication channel is not properly secured.
assumptions: Assumes data is transmitted over a network connection

title: Unauthorized Data Access
description: The health log store may allow unauthorized access to stored health data by users, administrators, or third parties who do not have proper authorization to view or process the health information.
assumptions: Assumes the data store has access controls that may be bypassed

title: Data Unavailability
description: Health log data stored in the health log store may become unavailable to authorized users due to system failures, maintenance, or intentional data deletion, potentially affecting users' ability to access their health information when needed.
assumptions: Assumes the data store may experience technical issues or intentional data management actions

title: Unintended Location Tracking
description: The companion mobile app shares GPS location traces with timestamps to the location history store, enabling continuous tracking of user movement patterns and behavior.
assumptions: The app has access to GPS sensors and is configured to record location data.

title: Individual Identification via Location Data
description: Location traces with timestamps can be used to identify and track specific individuals, potentially revealing personal habits, routines, and sensitive locations.
assumptions: Location data is unique enough to identify individuals, especially when combined with timestamps.

title: Unintended Disclosure During Transmission
description: GPS location data in transit between the app and location history store could be intercepted by unauthorized parties, leading to unintended disclosure of sensitive location information.
assumptions: Data transmission may not be fully encrypted or may be intercepted on public networks.

title: Location Data Storage and Retention
description: The location history store retains GPS traces, creating a persistent record of user movements that could be accessed by unauthorized parties or used for profiling.
assumptions: The store maintains historical location data without proper retention policies.

title: Identification via Stored Location History
description: Stored location traces with timestamps enable identification and tracking of individuals over time, potentially revealing sensitive personal information.
assumptions: Location data is stored in a manner that preserves its identifying characteristics.

title: Unintended Access to Location History
description: The location history store may be accessed by unauthorized parties, leading to unintended disclosure of sensitive location information.
assumptions: Access controls on the location history store may be insufficient.

title: Health Data Linkage Across Sessions
description: Calorie, weight, and exercise logs collected across multiple sessions can be linked to identify individuals, potentially enabling health profile reconstruction and longitudinal tracking of sensitive health conditions.
assumptions: Assumes session identifiers or timestamps may be included in the data flow

title: Potential Lack of Explicit Consent for Analytics
description: Health log data being shared for analytics purposes may not have explicit, informed consent from data subjects, particularly for cross-session health condition analysis.
assumptions: Assumes consent mechanisms may not cover all analytics use cases

title: Health Data Interception During Transit
description: Sensitive health information (calorie, weight, exercise logs) transmitted between Health Log Store and Analytics Service could be intercepted by unauthorized parties during data flow.
assumptions: Assumes data may be transmitted over networks without end-to-end encryption

title: Health Condition Analysis Disclosure
description: The analytics service may process and potentially disclose health condition analysis results to third parties or make them accessible without proper authorization controls.
assumptions: Assumes analytics outputs may be shared or exposed

title: Extended Health Data Retention for Analytics
description: Health logs retained for cross-session health condition analysis may be kept longer than necessary, increasing risk of unauthorized access and data breaches.
assumptions: Assumes retention policies may not be time-limited

title: Insufficient legal basis for data sharing
description: The Health Analytics Service may share inferred health insights without a clear legal basis or adequate consent from users, potentially violating data protection requirements.

title: Inaccurate or misleading health insights
description: The inferred health-condition risk indicators, routine summaries, and trend flags may be inaccurate or misleading, potentially causing users to make incorrect health decisions.

title: Lack of notification about data sharing
description: Users may not be adequately notified about the nature and extent of health insights being shared with the Companion Mobile App.

title: Data flow metadata exposure
description: Meta-data about the parties being used to link or identify them may be exposed during data transmission, potentially enabling correlation attacks.

title: Unauthorized disclosure of health insights
description: The Companion Mobile App may disclose the received health insights to third parties without proper authorization or user consent.

title: Unintended use of health insights
description: The Companion Mobile App may use the health insights in ways not intended by the user or the Health Analytics Service, potentially leading to privacy violations.

title: Unauthorized Access to Sensitive Health Data
description: The app shares eating-disorder and diabetes risk indicators with the user, which could be accessed by unauthorized parties if the app is compromised or if the user's device is not properly secured.
assumptions: The app has appropriate security controls in place, but these may not be sufficient to prevent all unauthorized access.

title: Inaccurate or Misleading Health Indicators
description: The app displays inferred condition indicators that may be inaccurate, incomplete, or misleading, potentially causing the user to make incorrect health decisions or miss important medical information.
assumptions: The app's algorithms and data sources are reliable, but there may be limitations in the accuracy of the inferred indicators.

title: Data Interception During Transmission
description: Health-related data transmitted from the app to the user could be intercepted by unauthorized parties during transit, potentially exposing sensitive personal health information.
assumptions: The data flow uses appropriate encryption and security measures, but these may not be sufficient to prevent all interception attempts.

title: Uncontrolled Data Sharing by User
description: The user may not have appropriate controls over who can access or share the health information displayed on the app dashboard, potentially leading to unauthorized disclosure of sensitive health data.
assumptions: The user has appropriate privacy settings and controls, but these may not be sufficient to prevent all unauthorized sharing.

title: Unauthorized Access to Health Data
description: Third-party cloud hosting provider may have unauthorized access to sensitive health and location data, potentially leading to data breaches and privacy violations.

title: Data Loss at Cloud Provider
description: Cloud hosting provider may experience data loss due to technical failures, disasters, or operational errors, resulting in loss of health analytics data and models.

title: Lawfulness of Data Sharing
description: Sharing full health and location datasets with third-party cloud provider may lack proper legal basis or consent, potentially violating data protection laws.

title: Data Minimization Violation
description: Transferring full health and location dataset may include more data than necessary for the analytics purpose, violating data minimization principles.

title: Data-Centric Identification in Transit
description: Data in transit may contain metadata about parties (e.g., IP addresses, timestamps, data patterns) that could be used to link or identify individuals.
